name: Cormac mac Carthaig
text: Cormac mac Carthaig ruled Munster in the twelfth century. He backed the raising of Cormac's Chapel, the Romanesque church at Cashel, and later generations kept his name upon it. His enemies killed him in 1138. The chapel still stands on the Rock of Cashel.

okr.objective: Record Cormac mac Carthaig, the twelfth-century king of Munster behind Cormac's Chapel.
key_results: Set him as twelfth-century king of Munster.
Record his backing of the Romanesque chapel at Cashel that carries his name.
Note his death at rival hands in 1138.
